notes: 🌾 FARM QUESTIONS WORK IN EVERY PHRASING: 'where would be the best place to farm X', 'where does X drop', 'what drops X', 'how can I get X', 'best spot to farm X' — all of them route to farm data now. The owner's own words were the failure: the best-place phrasing matched no farm pattern, skipped the whole farm brain, and landed on the don't-know card (and the research dig then searched the whole sentence and found nothing). Both halves are fixed at the root; his exact question is fixture #1, and the bare 'best place to farm' gets the general answer — Gabii, Helene, Void Cascade — it always should have.

🔎 NOT IN THE VAULT? HE LOOKS IT UP HIMSELF: any factual question the database can't answer — a farm spot for something newer than the Vault's data, a mechanic, a name — now triggers the research dig AUTOMATICALLY: live game data → the Warframe Wiki (drop and acquisition info included, not just page intros) → Wikipedia, and the answer names the actual spot with its source cited. Research buttons survive only as extras after an attempted answer, never instead of one. The honest don't-know is now the true last resort.

🧠 GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, HONESTLY LABELED (AI mode): when the Vault misses AND research comes back empty, the downloaded AI answers from its own general knowledge under a plain label — '🧠 From my general knowledge (not Vault data)'. Three sources, three labels, never blurred: Vault data / Researched (cited) / General knowledge. General answers still pass Vaulty's validation — a draft that invents a build is discarded — and build questions never reach them: builds come only from the verified engine, in every mode.

💬 VAULTY ACTUALLY CONVERSES NOW: say 'how are we', 'hello Vaulty', 'thanks', 'tell me a joke' or 'who are you' and you get a real reply in his voice — varied, not one canned line — in quick mode AND with the AI loaded (there, the model itself gets first crack at chat). The don't-know card and its research buttons now belong only to factual Warframe questions that live research genuinely couldn't answer. Small talk is conversation, and it's treated like it.

⬇️ THE DOWNLOAD IS ONE-TIME — BY LAW: Vaulty now detects the AI by probing its cache directly, never by any version flag, so an app update can NEVER ask you to download it again — if it's on your device, the status says 'AI ready on this device' and it just loads. A different brain (a newer model, or the size you pick in settings) is only ever an OPTIONAL offer — 'your current one keeps working either way' — and nothing is replaced until the new one is verified running. If your phone silently clears the download to free up space, he says exactly that, once, with the one-tap re-download — no nagging, no loops.

📱 ANY DEVICE WITH A REAL GPU CAN RUN THE AI: the old iPhone ban is gone. Eligibility is a real capability check on every OS alike — a WebGPU adapter that must pass an actual graphics probe, storage headroom, sane memory — iPhone, Android, desktop, one rule. No GPU or a failed probe → quick guide mode with one honest line about why. And the safety stack that replaces the ban: opt-in tap only, the phone-sized model on phones, a load watchdog, and a crash-loop detector — if loads keep dying on a device, the AI turns itself off there with a plain explanation and quick mode carries on.

🌡 NEW: AI PERFORMANCE SETTINGS (panel, 'AI performance'): one-tap presets — Cool & quiet, Balanced, Max power — plus your own knobs: reply length, context size, model size, and 'prefer cool running on battery' (unplugged → Cool behavior automatically, where the browser reports battery state). They change real engine parameters (reply caps, the context window handed to the model, generation pacing), they're saved on your device only, updates never reset them, and choices made before downloading apply at the download. Honest note, also in the panel: no browser API can read your phone's temperature, so Cool mode works by limiting how hard and how long the model runs — not by watching a thermometer.

🎯 NAMED ITEMS WIN, EVERY TIME: ask for a build for a specific frame or weapon — by name, in any phrasing — and the answer is about THAT item. A routing bug let named asks fall through to the generic 'most popular builds' list (the owner's own 'general build for nyx' came back as Kuva Zarr one-shots). Two root causes, both fixed: 3-letter names (Nyx, Ash) were invisible to the in-sentence matcher, and question parsing mangled 'build me a…' openers. One entity-first resolver now feeds every path — plain builds, qualified asks, the Workshop, power asks, the Build Checker, farm questions and conversation follow-ups (a named Nyx can no longer be hijacked as a 'follow-up' about the previous frame).

⚖️ 'GENERAL' IS A REAL ASK NOW: 'general build for X' serves that item's balanced all-rounder from the library instead of ignoring the word — Nyx gets her Steel Path Balanced build — and general frame answers state the frame's real ability breakpoints, computed from the build's own mods: Psychic Bolts fully strips armor and shields at 125% Ability Strength, and her general build runs 168%, so the answer says so with the math shown.

📋 THE POPULAR LIST STAYS IN ITS LANE: it now answers ONLY genuinely item-less browsing — 'show me popular builds', 'what's strong right now', a bare 'builds?' — and those phrasings no longer dead-end on the don't-know card either.

🎲 VAULTY ANSWERS FOR ITSELF: 'could you find me a good warframe to use' used to get the canned don't-know — that failure is fixture #1 now. A new recommender reasons over the whole Vault (roles, stats, mastery, farm sources, build tags): 2–3 real picks, WHY each fits, one honest trade-off each, and a follow-up offer. No goal stated? It spreads across roles — a survivor, a deleter, a backbone — and asks one sharpening question back. And the ordering is fixed everywhere: research and composing run BEFORE the honest don't-know can appear.

📱 THE VAULTY AI DOWNLOAD COMES TO PHONES — carefully: capability check first (WebGPU, free storage, memory), the smallest phone-sized model, explicit tap only (it NEVER auto-starts), a progress bar with a real Cancel, one-tap off switch and one-tap delete. On iPhone it's labeled EXPERIMENTAL and guarded: if a load dies mid-flight, Vaulty settles into quick mode and never loops — the v2.19.3 crash loop cannot come back. Desktop behavior is unchanged.

🧠 GROW, LEARN, COMMUNICATE: 👍/👎 now sit under real answers and genuinely re-rank recommendations — on your device only. Missed questions collect in a 'What Vaulty is learning' view (plus the anonymous text-only log, as before), and 'how do you learn?' gets the honest answer: local memory + anonymous misses + your votes, no secret retraining. Recommendations and explanations arrive in the conversational prose you asked for, not cards.

🔎 BUILD CHECKER: paste YOUR build ('check my Saryn Prime build: …') and Vaulty verifies it — every mod real, class/slot legal, no duplicates, capacity vs REAL drain data — naming exact problems (including mod names it doesn't recognize, never silently 'corrected') and suggesting swaps that are themselves verified legal.

🎒 MY ARSENAL + 👁 FARM WATCH: say 'I have Saryn Prime' and recommendations start from gear you own (unowned picks say what they take to get). Say 'I'm farming Lith A1' and Vaulty names the best source and watches the live feed while the app is open — nudging you when a matching fissure, alert or invasion is live. One watch at a time, stored on-device, 'stop watch' clears it.

☀️ DAILY BRIEF, CHIPS, VOICE, LIVE STAMPS: opening the chat shows one compact daily line (Baro, today's Sortie, daily reset) — real worldstate only, once a day, dismissible. Real answers grow follow-up chips ('Steel Path version?', 'Where do I farm it?') — never on a don't-know. Live answers now say when the feed answered ('live as of …') and invasions are covered. Voice is in and out where the browser supports it: a mic button (hidden entirely when unavailable) and spoken replies that are OFF by default with a panel toggle.

🔍 GENERALITY PASS: the Workshop, the dossier writer and the research brain were audited line by line to prove nothing in them is hard-wired to any one frame or weapon — then the last special cases were removed. The Helminth replacement pick is now ONE rule for every frame (the new ability takes the slot of whichever ability the frame's own kit values least — distraction and crowd-control abilities first), and the play rotation's advice is read off each ability's real description instead of anyone's name.

🧪 PROOF, NOT PROMISES: a new 233-check sweep runs the identical pipeline over frames and weapons that were never test cases — Wisp, Garuda, Revenant, Saryn and Hildryn dossiers, Acceltra Prime, Kuva Zarr and Desert Wind (which has no library build at all), fishing, Eidolon hunts, Kuva Liches and a lore question — verifying real mods, legal slots, real Helminth donors and replacements, and zero cross-item bleed-through. Hildryn correctly gets Nourish, not her own Pillage handed back to her.

Guardrails unchanged: every mod is still database-verified, fabricated mod names are still rejected, composed builds still carry the 🛠 Vaulty Original label, and the dossier math is still computed from the build itself.

🗣 CONVERSATIONAL VAULTY: Vaulty now answers general questions the way a person would — researched first, in natural prose. Ask how an ability works, how to farm something, who a character is, or how two mods compare, and Vaulty digs through the guide, live game data, the Warframe Wiki AND the pages the Wiki links to, cross-checks the sources, then writes you a real answer with a "Researched just now" source line. No more quoted extract dumps.

💥 POWER DOSSIERS: superlative build asks ("best Octavia Prime build where she kills anything… survival and destroying everything") no longer return the same stock card. They open the Workshop for a full dossier: a named concept ("Room Melter"), an intro on how the build destroys and survives, Aura + Exilus + 8 mods each with a why tied to the concept, two arcanes, a Helminth subsume with reasoning (Octavia gets Pillage over Resonator, from Hildryn — strip plus scaling synergy), an Archon Shard setup, a numbered play rotation, and a follow-up offer.

📐 HONEST MATH: the dossier's "why this works" section computes its numbers from the build itself — total Ability Strength is summed from the actual mods, and claims like armor-strip-per-cast are derived from the real formula (Pillage: 25% × strength; full strip at 400%, or 328% with Corrosive Projection). If the honest number is two casts, the answer says two casts.

🧵 SESSION CONTINUITY: Vaulty remembers what you were just talking about (this session, on-device only). After an Octavia answer, "and for steel path survival?" resolves to Octavia, Steel Path, survival — and shows you the context it used.

Guardrails unchanged: every mod is still database-verified (buildIsValid + capacity), fabricated mod names are still rejected, composed builds still carry the 🛠 Vaulty Original label, and the model still never authors a mod list — in AI mode it writes only the connective prose around the engine's verified dossier, from retrieved facts only.

🛠 THE WORKSHOP: Vaulty can now invent builds — never mods. Creative asks ("design a full damage build for Acceltra", "make me a weird off-meta Braton build", "come up with a Saryn build focused on Spores") open the Workshop: Vaulty researches the item live (damage split, crit/status profile), composes an original build from real database mods only, then verifies every pick — slot legality plus a capacity sanity check — before anything is shown.

Composed builds render on the standard build card (Copy build / Copy compact included) with a "🛠 Vaulty Original — composed just now from real mods" label and a why-line for every mod drawn from its real database effect. If a composition fails any check, the proven library build serves instead — an invalid build is never displayed.

AI mode guardrail extended: the on-device model may discuss archetypes and emphasis around an engine-made build, but it still may not author mod lists — and an answer naming a mod that doesn't exist anywhere in the Vault's data is now discarded and replaced automatically.

Plain exact asks ("steflos build") stay instant from the library, and qualified asks (budget / status / crit, v2.19.6) keep their verified behavior — the Workshop is the composer when you ask for something new.

Vaulty RESEARCHES now: when the built-in guide doesn't know, Vaulty looks it up live — live game data first, then the Warframe Wiki, then Wikipedia — behind a 'Researching…' progress bar with named stages and a Stop button. Findings are quoted from the source and cited ('From the Warframe Wiki — read more'); if research finds nothing, the honest don't-know stays. Research never invents builds: mod lists still come only from the verified library.

Downloaded the on-device AI once? You never download it again. Vaulty detects the model on this device and loads it straight from there after every app update — no re-download prompt, ever (regression-tested). The status line now says exactly that: 'AI ready on this device'.

Vaulty remembers — on this device only. Your most-asked frames/weapons and topics (stored in your browser, never uploaded) power a welcome-back greeting, a '⭐ My usual' chip, and asking for 'my usual'. Tap '🧠 What Vaulty remembers' in the chat to see exactly what's stored and clear it in one tap.
